findings.detail: Four validated GDPR units resolve with exact source, unit and local fidelity hashes.
Seven substantive sections across one knowledge note and one question have exact note and section bindings.
The lot adds rights routing without duplicating the already reviewed DPIA and FRIA notes.
Current amendments and supervisory interpretations were not assessed.
The note is routing knowledge; it does not decide a project-specific right, exception or response.
